description: This file defines the NameExpression class used in Twig template engine for handling variable name expressions within templates. It includes logic for compilation of variable access with handling for special variables, strict variable checks, and deprecation warnings.

classes.name: NameExpression
classes.description: Represents a variable name expression in Twig templates, capable of compiling PHP code to retrieve the variable from the context with support for special variables and strict checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a NameExpression instance with a variable name and line number. Emits a deprecation warning if the class is used directly.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for accessing the variable in the given context, handling special variables, defined tests, global context access, and strict variable checking.

methods.name: isSpecial
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if the variable name is a special variable.

methods.name: isSimple
methods.description: Deprecated method to check if the expression is a simple variable (not special and not a defined test).
